scope: Existing authoritative player, committed SWD001+LGT001 only; explicit Bound and Hurt presentation flags

nominal_source_sampling.role: nominal author preview sampling; not gameplay termination authority

frame_selector: Actual float AnimationTime promoted to double: <.1 =>0, <.2 =>1, <.3 =>2, otherwise3 while actual eligibility remains true.
positive_float_tail: Real positive native remaining remains eligible and selects phase3 even if actual age is at/after nominal400ms. Plan records the unchanged native age/remaining.
end: Actual native HurtTime/label/death determine the end. No presentation hold across the actual end, no added timer, no early Ready0, no gameplay extension.
pause_continue: Already published valid owner remains observable during AwaitExplicitContinue. Query/plan cannot advance time, open the gate, or change committed equipment.
geometry: All phases share 512 canvas and416 standing extent to72 display; UIScale is applied once. No per-frame alpha-height normalization.
